sections.title: Professional summary
paragraphs: Business development and operations professional with experience across manufacturing, international sales, language education, and urban mobility. Combines client relationship management, team leadership, and process improvement with hands-on development of software and automation tools. His experience also includes teaching.

sections.title: General Manager, Operations — Pakiş Ambalaj A.Ş.
paragraphs: Location: Izmir, Türkiye.
Descriptive title reflecting responsibilities in a family-owned business that did not use formal titles. Worked with senior family stakeholders and directed operations.
bullets: Led day-to-day operations and coordinated business development, customer relationships, and product development.
Developed export markets and maintained relationships with key customers.
Created and maintained operating procedures, company policies, and staff training materials.
Oversaw company quality and management-system certification work.
Coordinated customer requirements with manufacturing, including product design, materials, and mold development.

sections.title: Operations Manager — Pagysa A.Ş.
paragraphs: Location: Türkiye.
Descriptive title reflecting oversight of purchasing, production, and satellite production facilities in a company that did not use formal titles.
bullets: Oversaw the buying process and production activities across the company's satellite facilities.
Oversaw implementation work for ISO 9001 quality management and HACCP food safety controls as part of the company's operational transition.
Developed and implemented lot-level fruit traceability from farms in the Aegean region through processing and delivery to major food manufacturers across Europe, responding to customer requirements.
Helped turn a previously unresolved traceability challenge into a proven operational capability and a competitive advantage for the company.
Started and managed a sun-dried tomato project covering sourcing, processing, packaging, and sales to European markets.

sections.title: CareerTalkLab
paragraphs: Status: Work in progress.

Building a learning platform that began as a project for personal learning and is evolving into a long-term personal effort to share knowledge and help others learn. Business English is one part of the platform, with a data analytics curriculum planned as an additional offering. CareerTalkLab remains a work in progress, with a growing emphasis on paying it forward.
